outcomes.text: Work out the size of a box
Lay out a page for phones and dark mode

questions.prompt: Which selector picks every element with class="card"?
questions.explain: A dot picks a class. A # picks an id, and a bare word picks a tag such as p.

questions.prompt: A box has width: 200px, padding: 20px and border: 2px solid. box-sizing is the default. How wide is it on screen?
questions.explain: The default is content-box. Padding and border are added on both sides: 200 + 20 + 20 + 2 + 2 = 244.

questions.prompt: Now add box-sizing: border-box to the same box. How wide is it?
questions.explain: With border-box, the width includes padding and border. The box stays 200px wide.

questions.prompt: Cards in a flex row run off a phone screen. Which line lets them move onto a new line?
questions.explain: flex-wrap decides if flex items stay on one line or wrap onto more lines.

questions.prompt: Which rule applies styles only when the device is set to dark mode?
questions.explain: prefers-color-scheme reads the light or dark setting of the device or browser.
